# AliExpress

> > AliExpress is a global ecommerce platform enabling wholesale and retail purchases of products from sellers worldwide.

AliExpress, operated by Alibaba Group, is a major online marketplace connecting international buyers with Chinese manufacturers and sellers. The platform specializes in wholesale purchasing, bulk orders, and direct-to-consumer retail shopping across numerous product categories.

## Key Topics

- AliExpress
- Alibaba Group
- wholesale
- ecommerce platform
- bulk purchasing
- buyer accounts
- shopping interface
- user navigation
- global marketplace
- direct sales

## Wholesale & Bulk Purchasing

- [AliExpress Wholesale](https://www.aliexpress.com/wholesale.html): AliExpress wholesale shopping platform for bulk buyer purchases
